scope: Stock worldserver logging and retained configuration

retainedConfiguration.environment: Linux host with verified stock provider content and a disposable state directory
retainedConfiguration.method: Rendered the complete active configuration with the signed v24 helper, then rendered and verified it against v25 in the same directory.

nativeConsole.environment: Packaged Linux ARM64 worldserver under qemu-user
nativeConsole.method: Launched through each version's ServerChild with the same generated configuration and closed loopback SQL endpoint. Both native processes initialized logging and exited with status 1 at the expected SQL boundary.

itemDebugTraversal.method: Compiled the pinned bodies of RandomItemMgr::DebugCacheRandomItem, Log::ShouldLog and AppenderFile::_write with a synthetic item store, logger dispatch, the pinned fmt headers and a real file sink. Counted item lookups, submitted lines and calls to fflush.
itemDebugTraversal.scope: Counts cover only the optional item detail dump. The core item cache loader and enabled account bot behavior continue to run.
